none: PAS HESH-9E74C6: Roman coin: Denarius of Trajan Decius
contea di ritrovamento: Shropshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Rally ID: 45. Roman coin: A struck / hammered silver denarius. It is possibly a denarius of Trajan Decius. It appears to have been struck from low-grade silver. Obverse: Laureled head facing right. Obverse inscription: ....CAESAR TR [ ] AVG [ ]. Reverse: Female figure standing left. Reverse inscription: .....COS III [ ]. Diameter: 18.5mm. Weight: 2.5g
